a = np.array(Image.open('first_frame.png')).astype(int)

def classify(r,g,b):
    mx,mn = max(r,g,b),min(r,g,b)
    if mx<60: return '#'          # dark/black
    if r>150 and g<95 and b<95: return 'R'  # red
    if r>170 and g>140 and b<120 and r>=g-10 and g>b+40: return 'Y' # yellow
    if abs(r-g)<25 and abs(g-b)<25:
        return '.' if mx>180 else ('-' if mx>120 else ':')  # grays
    if b>r and b>g: return 'B'
    if g>r and g>b: return 'G'
    if r>g and r>b and r<200: return 'o'
    return '?'

# 4x4 blocks -> 64x36
for yy in range(0,H,4):
    row=''
    for xx in range(0,W,4):
        blk = a[yy:yy+4,xx:xx+4].reshape(-1,3)
        # most common category
        from collections import Counter
        c = Counter(classify(*p) for p in blk)
        row += c.most_common(1)[0][0]
    print(row)
EOF"
